fields.Property Note:
Subject to tax cert NO.25–00110 10/29/2025 in the amount of $8269.90 plus subsequent charges, interested parties must obtain and pay red redemption amount with borough of Lindenwold.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens, or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums, or other advances me by the plaintiff prior to the sale. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B – 21 the sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any condominium/homeowners association association liens, which may exist.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether to not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so current amount due theron.
